svg.aria-label: False-positive triage bench: a fresh domain token stamped with a NEW lock rides a track through three bays — a Certificate-Transparency log scanner drum, a verdict chamber where the bot's PHISHING stamp comes down (the false positive), and an appeal gate releasing a cleared token. The readout shows flag latency of hours to days, review turnaround of 24 to 72 hours, and the /signin trigger endpoint; the bench is engraved with the fixes: request review via Search Console Security Issues, and X-Robots-Tag noindex on /signin.

g.text: FIX 1 · SEARCH CONSOLE → SECURITY ISSUES → REQUEST REVIEW
